description: Simulates a network partition that isolates subsets of verifiers, allowing conflicting traces to be certified in different partition halves, creating irreconcilable state commitments.
mitigation_target: Partition-Aware Quorum, Conflict Detection Pre-Healing, Causality Tracking

execution_phases.name: initial_consensus
execution_phases.description: All verifiers operational, establishing baseline consensus

execution_phases.name: partition_induction
execution_phases.description: Network partition severs communication between groups A and B

execution_phases.name: divergent_certification
execution_phases.description: Conflicting traces submitted to each partition half

execution_phases.name: conflict_resolution
execution_phases.description: System attempts to reconcile divergent histories

attack_vectors.name: Partition Detection Bypass
attack_vectors.description: Adversary crafts partition to avoid detection by heartbeat mechanisms

attack_vectors.name: Strategic Routing Exploitation
attack_vectors.description: Adversary routes conflicting traces to specific partition halves

invariant_checks.description: Total value in system remains constant
Each nonce used at most once per address
All verifiers eventually agree on state

critical: Quorum achieved without global connectivity proof
high: Partition detection delays create exploitation window
Asymmetric partition causes inconsistent failure detection

tests.description: Verify partition-aware quorum rejects certification during partition
Verify conflict detection identifies divergent histories

success_criteria: No dual certification of conflicting traces
All verifiers converge to same state within 30 seconds of healing
